```yaml
name: Lint

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GITHUB_PAT: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup R
        uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r@v2
        with:
          r-version: 'release'

      - name: Setup R dependencies
        uses: r-lib/actions/setup-r-dependencies@v2
        with:
          extra-packages: |
            any::lintr
            any::styler
            .
          needs: dev

      - name: Configure lintr
        run: |
          mkdir -p .lintr
          cat > .lintr/lint.R << 'EOF'
          lintr::lint_package(
            linters = lintr::linters_with_defaults(
              line_length_linter = lintr::line_length_linter(120),
              indentation_linter = lintr::indentation_linter(indent_by = 2)
            )
          )
          EOF
        shell: bash

      - name: Run lintr
        run: |
          Rscript -e 'lintr::lint_package()'
        shell: bash

      - name: Run styler check
        run: |
          Rscript -e 'styler::style_pkg()'
        shell: bash

      - name: Check for styling changes
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code || (echo "Code is not styled correctly. Please run styler::style_pkg() locally." && exit 1)
        shell: bash

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          Rscript -e 'devtools::load_all(); testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test-huxtable-creation.R")'
        shell: bash
```
